Name: IOSS GmbH
Description: IOSS GmbH has been developing and producing intelligent reading and evaluation systems for directly marked data matrix coding for over 20 years. The systems are used successfully worldwide in the automotive sector, in the semiconductor industry, in automation and in medical technology. The product range includes stationary code readers, wafer ID systems, OCR readers, handheld scanners and various products for code quality assessment. The systems read Data Matrix codes, QR codes, barcodes and OCR. IOSS GmbH specializes in reading DPM codes, which are codes that are applied directly to components. The systems offer a significant advantage, especially when reading dot peen codes. With the readers from IOSS, the products are identified clearly and securely, even under the most demanding conditions, such as curved, reflective or painted surfaces. In addition to the normal reading of codes, the systems also evaluate the quality of the codes reliably and reproducibly. The systems are calibrated and verified according to standard ISO/IEC 29158. For dot peen marked DPM codes, IOSS GmbH has created its own validation standard, "Rated Reading" with special criteria that enable reliable and reproducible monitoring of the marking quality.

They are widely used in automation and industrial robotics, in the field of machine tools manufacturing, in the navigation and camera equipment, medical systems, and in many other applications. 
SPINEA enjoys the membership of international robotics associations, such as the International Federation of Robotics, EU Robotics, MCMA as well as the German Engineering Federation - VDMA.

Name: INOCON GmbH
Description:
INOCON – Solutions that connect
It all began in 1997 in a small office in the heart of Rheinbach. Today, INOCON is one of the leading providers of assembly components such as tube clamps and linear units.
New production methods, maximum quality, customer-specific special solutions, short delivery times and solid technical advice make INOCON a reliable and competent partner. INOCON is the first choice for anything having to do with positioning systems, multi-axis systems or mechanisms in plant construction.

The selection is continually expanding according to the special needs of customers in a wide range of industries, from labelling technology and food production to research and development systems.

After all, the individually developed solutions often find their way into the standard portfolio, especially if they would benefit all customers. INOCON thinks in practical terms.

That was already the case back when Walter-Franz Marxen founded the company. As an engineer and head of a design office for special machinery, he knew there was always a lack of universal standard elements.

The company has a particular interest in tube clamps and linear units, in other words elements that have always been indispensable in plant construction. INOCON develops its own products with the goal of offering better solutions than typical providers on the market.
With the move to the Rheinbach industrial region in 2005, the company began expanding its own production line to respond more quickly and flexibly to highly individual customer needs – even at small part volumes.

The capabilities were continually upgraded, including installation of a powder-coating plant and other CNC machines. In the meantime, INOCON now has multiple production buildings. All this means that INOCON is able to deliver within 48 hours of receiving an order – and overnight express is available for especially urgent orders.

Name: Industry Business Network 4.0 e.V.
Description:
Mittelstand vernetzen, Standards setzen, durchstarten: Der Verband Industry Business Network 4.0 e.V. wurde von innovativen mittelständischen Unternehmen, die zum Thema Industrie 4.0 kooperieren wollen, im Herbst 2016 gegründet. Der Verband wurde dabei im Rahmen des ersten Fachkongresses „Fertigung 4.0“ unter der Schirmherrschaft von Staatsministerin Ilse Aigner im bayerischen Bad Wörishofen der Öffentlichkeit präsentiert.

 

Die Mitgliedschaft im Verband steht allen Unternehmen, Institutionen und Personen offen, die aktiv an der Umsetzung von Industrie 4.0 im Mittelstand mitarbeiten möchten. Der Verband versteht sich dabei als branchenunabhängiger Zusammenschluss innovativer Hersteller, Dienstleister und Anwender. Durch Kooperation auf Augenhöhe werden die Mehrwerte von Industrie 4.0 umsetzungsorientiert durch den Verband fokussiert.
Dazu hat es sich der Verband zur konkreten Aufgabe gemacht, eine Implementierungsguideline für die industrielle Vernetzung von Anlagen, Vorrichtungen und Komponenten im Zusammenhang mit Industrie 4.0 zu entwickeln. Bei der Umsetzung wird dabei auf bestehende Standards, Normen und Guidelines, beispielsweise OPC UA, aufgesetzt und diese im Sinne der Verbandsziele erweitert.

Name: alcemy
Description:
30+ Cement Plants Reached | Integrated in over 50% of German Cement Plants |  

Concrete is the most widely used building material on our planet. The only thing mankind uses more of is water. With a wave of urban development coming in the next few decades, concrete is also a rapidly growing trillion-dollar market. However, cement and concrete production is responsible for 8% of the global CO2 emissions, making its growth a big cause for concern.

Low-carbon concrete exists - but until now it has been too sophisticated to be produced reliably and on a large scale. It contains very little burnt limestone - responsible for the strength of concrete and CO2 emissions. This makes low-carbon concrete vulnerable to fluctuations in raw materials and operating conditions and thus difficult to produce with reliable quality. Adding to the challenge: the final quality of concrete can only be measured weeks AFTER it has been processed on the construction site - far too late to be corrected. This is why our world is still built on more robust, high-carbon concrete. 

Using alcemy's software, cement and concrete producers receive precise quality predictions already during production. Based on these prediction models, our AI identifies which production parameters need to be adjusted to mitigate the impact of fluctuations. Thus, the quality of cement and concrete can be optimized BEFORE delivery – for the first time in history.

The result is significantly more consistent product quality, allowing producers to safely replace burnt limestone with less expensive, low-carbon materials found in nature. In this way, they can also avoid payments for CO2 emission certificates in the EU. 

Saving costs, bringing production processes up to speed for 21st century concrete recipes, and saving half of Europe’s CO2 emissions goes hand in hand at alcemy. Join us on our journey to make low-carbon concrete a reality!

Name: Innok Robotics
Description:
Innok Robotics, based in Regenstauf (north of Regensburg), has been one of the technology and market leaders in highly innovative ‘autonomous mobile robots’ (AMRs) since 2012. These robots can operate outdoors on all surfaces and in all weather conditions, and Innok Robotics is one of the few manufacturers worldwide to offer this technology.
 

At the heart of these innovative mobile robots is Innok Robotics' proprietary autonomy software, InnokCockpit.
From development and programming to assembly, Innok Robotics offers its customers everything from a single source.
 

The unique selling point of Innok robots is that they not only operate indoors in perfectly prepared halls, but are also ‘multi-terrain’ capable. They can drive indoors even on poor-quality floors and without structural measures to the buildings, as well as outdoors in all weather conditions and over obstacles such as ramps and speed bumps.
 

The core products are the INDUROS autonomous transport robot, which is primarily aimed at all companies involved in material transport and automates transport between halls, for example, and the RAINOS watering robot, which can water parking areas and is currently mainly used in cemeteries for the autonomous watering of graves.

Its customers include successful small businesses, medium-sized companies and large international corporations such as BASF, Roche, Bosch, Kubota, Infineon, K+S, ZF, the Port of Hamburg, Fraunhofer Institutes, universities and many cemetery gardeners.

These analyzers are mostly used in environmental laboratories, water treatment institutes, plants for control of drinking and surface water, food industries, agriculture, waste disposal agencies etc.

Since 2023, Skalar has been part of the Skalar group:

Maddox AI supports more than 60 manufacturing companies worldwide. Our systems are deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. Our solutions are used in industries including automotive, electronics, medical technology, and food production.

Name: IO-Link
Description:
Where simple data such as on/off used to suffice, intelligent automation is now in demand. With IO-Link, the lowest field level becomes a valuabel digital data supplier. The manufacturer-independent and internationally renowned standard enables continuous communication of cyclic (process data) and acyclic (parameters & diagnostic data) data – down to the smallest sensor and actuator.
IO-Link is fieldbus-independent and opens up far more possibilities than just sensor / actuator connection:

•    Easy installation and integration
•    Cross-manufacturer compatibility
•    Complete transparency down to the sensor/actuator
•    Independent of the controllers and fieldbuses used
•    Configuration during operation

IO-Link is internationally standardized (IEC 61131) and the ideal solution for companies that want to connect their products to a wide variety of systems and controllers worldwide.

IO-Link Safety & Wireless: More Opportunities for the Industry

IO-Link Safety extends the technology to include functionally safe communication – for machines and systems that must meet safety-related requirements. IO-Link Wireless complements the system with reliable, real-time, deterministic wireless communication – ideal for flexible and mobile applications in factory automation. Both technologies have been successfully adapted without compromising on the well-known reliability.

IO-Link on the Road to Success Worldwide

Behind the technology is the IO-Link Community with well over 500 member companies worldwide and a steadily growing product portfolio of more than 30,000 solutions. It guarantees innovation, interoperability, and strong industrial networking. More than 71 million IO-Link devices are already in use worldwide – and the trend is rising: in 2025 alone, 9.7 million new IO-Link nodes were added.

Description:
Orion Additive Manufacturing is a pioneer in how the world 3D prints high-performance polymers. Founded in Berlin in 2018, we design and deliver advanced Additive Manufacturing (AM) systems to customers in aerospace, medicine, industry, and academia. 

Orion AM’s proprietary Thermal Radiation Heating (TRH) process allows our systems to print high-performance polymers with the strength and density of injection-molded parts. Eliminating the traditional issues of voids and poor interlayer bonding, Orion AM’s systems unlock polymers such as PEEK, PEKK, PEI, and PPSU for new geometries and new uses in outer space, implant applications, and load-bearing parts. 

To support these diverse applications, we offer three specialized systems: the large-format industrial A460, the desktop industrial A150, and the M150 medical system. Designed specifically for clinical environments, the M150 was notably used by Dr. Andreas Schwitalla at Charité University Hospital to develop and patent innovative 3D-printed dental implants. 

Beyond medicine, Orion AM printed the first 3D printed parts to be sent to the moon on the ESA Rashid rover. We also continue to develop innovative AM solutions for space as consortium partners in AM-SPACE, engineering 3D-printed components to make satellites lighter, more reliable, and more efficient.

Best-in-class 3D Collision Avoidance for mobile robots with the world's first 3D Ultrasonic Echolocation Sensor ECHO ONE.

MEYSENS (formerly Toposens) has developed the world's first 3D Ultrasonic Sensor System for obstacle detection and collision avoidance in mobile platforms. 
The sensor system ECHO ONE perceives its environment via the principle of echolocation, similar to a bat.

This is a completely new method of localizing 3D positions through ultrasound for the precise 3D detection of objects in real-time. Our know-how lies in the design of sophisticated algorithms, which are embedded in the sensor system. Name: AMEPA GmbH
Description:
Clean steel & perfect surface
From casting to the finished product, high-quality steel production and profits depend on the slag-free transfer of liquid steel.

With this premise, AMEPA started its first product development in 1984 in Aachen, Germany and installed its first slag detection systems in 1986. These systems have since become the industry standard, separating AMEPA as a trusted global market leader for years. With its branches in Cleveland, Ohio, USA (AMEPA America Inc.) and Shanghai, China (AMEPA Trading Co., Ltd.), as well as its global representative network, AMEPA is active worldwide with innovative systems.

In steel mills, aluminum rolling mills, and the automotive industry, AMEPA measuring systems are subject to the most harsh, heavy industrial applications, which must be incorporated into the system design to ensure a reliable process flow. Intensive individual testing of the components, as well as a complete system acceptance, guarantees quality products with high availability and long service life to ensure clean steel and a perfect surface.

Electromagnetic and thermographic slag detection, oil film thickness and surface roughness measurement, and coal injection flow are all competencies that AMEPA has been implementing in innovative technologies in industry for decades. We are going one step further with new product generations, both in digital signal evaluation and in the networking and data analysis, helping to advance Industry 4.0.

Name: BOWE - North America
Description:
The BOWE GROUP is one of the world’s leading suppliers of smart automation and IoT solutions for the entire internal added value chain and beyond. 

The Group’s strong brands are active in the fields of document and card processing, mail logistics as well as intralogistics and software. 
As part of the financially strong Possehl Group, for over 75 years our solutions have optimized work and production flows across a wide range of very different industries. BOWE GROUP NORTH AMERICA is growing in the US and Canada by continuing to innovate in our legacy document and card processing market while expanding our offerings into Intralogistics, warehouse automation and manufacturing. These newer solutions include parcel sorting systems, material handling equipment, Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), Warehouse Control/Warehouse Management Software (WMS/WCS) and (asset) tracking technology. 

While process automation has continued to evolve and get faster for decades, all processes have inputs and outputs often in the form of materials that are manually moved from point-to-point (i.e. paper to be printed; SKUs to be sorted to a retail store, Parcels to be sorted to a delivery destination, etc.). 

This led Bowe in 2023 to launch its “Move” Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) product line that is powered by Bowe/Mov.ai software. The Move AMRs are innovative “Cobots” (i.e. Cooperative Robot) that enable customers to move materials on carts and pallets in production environments that were in the past not possible to automate. 

Other offerings include Realtime Location Systems (RTLS) devices to track vehicles, people and assets seamlessly indoors and outdoors, to an exact location at all times. 

Bowe Group leverages this portfolio of products to provide turn-key automation solutions to our customers in North America and elsewhere

Description:
AIR TORQUE - Pneumatic actuators
Proven actuator technology at the highest level

THE COMPANY
With more than 30 years of experience in the industrial valve industry, Air Torque is a reliable partner for all automation needs.
Through active participation in the relevant national and international expert working groups, such as CEN/DIN or VDI/VDE, we are significantly involved in the standardization and definition of the technical requirements via standardization. The use of standardized components enables the user to optimally combine a wide variety of products and a minimum level of safety.

THE PRODUCTS
Air Torque drives are not only used in safety-related areas at leading companies in the chemical, oil and gas, shipbuilding, pharmaceutical and food industries, but are also used for special applications that require constant adaptation of the products.
In addition to the temperature or environmental requirements, product variations can also be defined, for example, via an extended rotation angle range, multi-positioning, hydraulic damping, fast or slow closing.

INNOVATIVE
The advantages often lie in the details, such as the consistently implemented involute gearing, the adjustable end position system or the low-wear rolling crank of the Scotch-Yoke actuators.
Air Torque's actuators are optimally scalable with torques from 10 Nm to 60,000 Nm thanks to the fine gradation of the individual sizes. Important to always ensure the required functional safety function. The selection of suitable materials and corrosion resistance is another part of our quality standards. This is confirmed, among other things, by the consistent SIL classification (TÜV Rheinland).

OUR PROMISE
• Large warehouse with over 50,000 drives
• technical Support in project planning and consulting
• competitive actuators for all applications

Description:
Pixel Robotics uses an optical AI recognition system to convert the real world of intralogistics into a digital real-time twin. The patented recognition system is used to track and digitise warehouse movements like of industrial trucks, goods and people. 
The real-time data obtained can be utilised in a wide range of applications: Visualization and optimization of intralogistics, reduction of errors and accidents through to the complete automation of manual processes.

The mission is to support the growth of the composite profiles industry by maximizing external communication efforts and having an actively contributing membership.

Pultrusion is a continuous manufacturing process of linear composite profiles made of polymeric resins such as polyesters and fiber reinforcement such as glass fibers. Automated Pultrusion Production Technology facilitates today's High Quality and Low-Cost demands by the market.

In 2002 the European Standard EN 13706 was published. The standard consists of three parts and specifies minimum requirements for the quality, tolerances, strength, stiffness and surface of structural profiles. It refers only to pultruded profiles for structural purposes.

The standard basically divides pultruded structural profiles into two classes:

    E23 – having the most stringent requirements to quality
    E17 – having more lenient requirements to quality

All members are bound by their own Quality Standards or project/product-specific approvals.

Since 2006, the Association has existed under the umbrella of the AVK – Industrievereinigung Verstärkte Kunststoffe e.V. in Germany/Frankfurt.

Membership is open to all participants in the sector so do no hesitate to join us !

Name: Kowa Optimed Deutschland GmbH
Description:
Go with perfection.
Machine vision & CCTV lenses, made in Japan for over 70 years.

The electronics and optics division of Kowa began the production of lenses in the 1940s. Shortly after that spotting scopes and binoculars were added to the product portfolio.

High quality and broad portfolio
From the beginning, Kowa positioned itself in the high quality segment of the market. Most Kowa optical products are designed and manufactured in Japan.

Over the years, the product lines of lenses in the CCTV/security, machine vision and traffic control (ITS) categories have become one of the most extensive in the market. In addition to the standard lens portfolio, Kowa also provides custom lens solutions to ensure that each customer finds the perfect fit with a Kowa product for any type of project.

Close to the customer
Since the beginning of the 1980s, Kowa has had a sales office in Europe. For the optical division, Kowa Optimed Deutschland GmbH serves the European market from Düsseldorf. A small, dedicated team of lens professionals provides sales and technical support for the European market. The European team works in close communication with the technical development and production in Japan.

Most lenses are on stock in Düsseldorf and can be shipped anywhere in Europe within a few days.

Name: OTTO ID Solutions
Description:

Partnering with us means a collaborative approach to identifying bottlenecks in your business operations. Through in-depth analysis, we create proof of concept solutions that streamline your workflows.

Our implementation of RFID technology is designed to achieve precise asset and stock management, streamline production processes, and ensure both security and quality. These solutions have been proven to save on labor, reduce item costs, prevent shortages, and effectively track and sort inventories.

At the core of our mission, we aim to eliminate manual operations and human errors, leading to increased productivity, cost savings, and fostering peace of mind among employees while achieving customer satisfaction.

Founded in 2018, with registration in both Germany and the USA, we invite you to join us in simplifying, securing, and scaling your business operations for future challenges.

AUTOMATE - INNOVATE - CARE!

Name: JVM Europe
Description:
We believe that every patient has the right to receive the correct medication – if it is one pill a day or if it is 10 pills a day. Patients should not have to worry if their pharmacy, hospital or caregiver is giving them the correct dosage at the correct time. Our products ensure that this worry is taken away and our solutions offer unparalleled accuracy and security. 

Our solutions can benefit the corner pharmacy with a few hundred customers, as well as a large hospital pharmacy with thousands of patients. Our products can be configured for any size business, and our customers are secure in the knowledge that they are helping their customers and patients in a highly effective and safe way, with an almost 0% chance of mistakes.

It is our vision to live in a world where any medication can be given safely and efficiently to all patients, with no fear of mistaken dosages.

Our mission, therefore, is to provide automated pharmaceutical solutions of the highest quality enabling our customers to deliver the right medicine in the right dosage at the right time and to the right patient.

Customer Commitment - Partnership - Innovation - Passion - Leadership – Quality

We take our vision of enduring excellence for the brand and for our customers seriously. Our corporate culture ensures that this occurs in an engaging and collaborative environment. We are steadfast in our adherence to these values that guide our interactions with customers, and colleagues. We believe our values are what make us unique and are essential to building a culture of excellence.

Today JVM Europe BV is the European leader in pharmaceutical automation solutions, with more than 1000 systems installed throughout Europe, and 10,000 worldwide.

JVM Europe (formerly known as HD Medi) was formed in June 2008 as a joint venture between the Dutch company, Dijkstra Vereenigde B.V. and the South Korean company, JVM Ltd. In July 2014, JVM Europe became a fully owned subsidiary of JVM Ltd.

Name: MetisMotion

Name: enerthing GmbH
Description:
Digitization often starts by interfacing to the real world with sensors and smart devices. Providing billions of devices with electrical energy is one of the big challenges of a growing internet of things.

The need for frequent replacement of batteries or labour- and cost-intensive wiring is not only a significant cost factor. The constraints in energy supply can also be a show-stopper for implementing new solutions. As a result, a large potential of the internet of things remains untapped.

Light is often an abundant source of energy – not only outdoors, but also indoors. Enerthing has developed the next generation photovoltaic film which can outperform batteries. Based on our core technology, we bring asset-tracking, indoor navigation and sensing in buildings to the next level combining high performance, maintenance-free operation and sustainability.

With our broad expertise ranging from manufacturing of high performance customizable photovoltaic films, energy efficient hardware and software systems design we develop new IoT solutions which push the boundaries of today’s battery powered and cable tied IoT world.

Description:
The Industrial Measurement Solution (IMS) team is part of VMT GmbH, based in Bruchsal, Germany. 

We are an official reseller of the 3D measurement and analysis software SpatialAnalyzer and for measurement accessories from Brunson Instruments. Furthermore, IMS is a provider of industrial metrology services worldwide with laser tracker, measuring arm and photogrammetry. Our team advises you on general metrological tasks, which measuring instruments are the right ones for your requirements and wishes - independent of OEMs, of course - and develops sophisticated measuring concepts together with you. We are the first contact for all SpatialAnalyzer users in German-speaking countries if they need technical support and training or are interested in the wide range of automation solutions. For special, repeatable measurement tasks or for the integration of measurement systems into production facilities, we develop individual and user-friendly SpatialAnalyzer automations for our customers. We classify our automation solutions into three levels: 
- smaller, operator-supporting automations 
- operator-guiding automations 
- fully automated processes including control of SPS or robots. 

Our customer pool is mainly found in the fields of mechanical engineering, aircraft construction, shipbuilding, railway engineering and aerospace. But also in tunnelling, medical technology and in research and education.

Description:
The Zell Group has been a trusted partner of industry for more than 25 years, constantly creating new solutions through its two divisions: »ZELL System Technology« and »ZELL Surface Technology«. Our customers are at home in the automotive industry, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering and medical technology. 

»ZELL System Technology« develops and supplies carrier systems and clips that enable manufactured parts to be transported, cleaned, washed and hardened with utmost precision. We help hundreds of companies throughout Europe to robotize and increasingly automate production processes. We design all our own systems. 

Our »ZELL Surface Technology« division specializes in providing high-performance metallic surfaces for critical components. Blasting pressures of up to 3,000 bar are not uncommon for components treated by us. Our precision blasting processes cover a broad spectrum – from deburring to the introduction of residual stress and material compression (shot peening). We develop tailor-made processes and equipment together with our customers in order to best meet their requirements. We are experts in mass production and are a reliable link in time-critical supply chains.

Name: PLCtrainingKIT .nl b.v.
Description:
PLCtrainingKIT was born to fill our teaching needs when we could not find an appropriate PLC trainer on the market. Until now the market offered either trivially simple boxes or very expensive, enormous hardware.
We have developed a stackable desktop case containing a PLC and four familiar scenarios. A train crossing, a car park, an elevator and a chocolate drink factory are chosen enabling the student to concentrate on programming rather than familiarising with the scenarios.
Still a great deal of analysis is required to deal with fault conditions, communication and human machine interaction.
All the wiring is done (including hall sensors, optical sensors, motors, displays digital and analogue i/o).
All a student needs to do is download the licence free software to begin programming or simulating at home.
Descriptions, manuals, i/o tables and programming tips are all freely available on the website along with the tasks and teacher guides.

Consulting:

Innovations: 
Carbon fibers, for example, have diamond-like structures that are best machined with diamond cutting materials. Solid diamond cutting edges can be ground to higher sharpness than laminated tools and have a long service life.

Description:
Die Smart Electronic Factory ist eine Informations- und Demonstrationsplattform für die Industrie 4.0. Diese Evaluierungsumgebung ist in einer realen Elektronikfabrik implementiert. Die unabhängige Mittelstandsoffensive, die aus spezialisierten Systemherstellern und Anwendungsanbietern besteht, entwickelt innovative Produktionsszenarien im Sinne der vierten industriellen Revolution.

Zielsetzung der Smart Electronic Factory ist es, die Anforderungen der Industrie 4.0 mittelfristig im Branchensegment Elektronik zu realisieren und auf weitere Branchen zu adaptieren.

Initiatoren der im Jahr 2014 gestarteten Mittelstandsoffensive sind der EMS-Dienstleister Limtronik GmbH, in dessen Fabrik die Smart Electronic Factory integriert ist, und die iTAC Software AG. Umgesetzt wird das Projekt von einem Industrie 4.0-Konsortium, bestehend aus mittelständischen deutschen Softwarehäusern wie iTAC, in-GmbH und DUALIS sowie internationalen Unternehmen. Auch universitäre Forschungseinrichtungen wie die Technische Hochschule Mittelhessen (THM) beteiligen sich hieran. 

Zu den konkreten Umsetzungen zählt es im ersten Schritt, Maschinenprozesse leistungsfähiger zu gestalten und Fehlerkosten zu minimieren. Bereits heute werden für jeden primären Fertigungsschritt Maschinen-, Prozess- und Qualitätsdaten eigenständig erfasst und analysiert.

Der Endausbau hat die selbstlernende Maschine im Sinne der Industrie 4.0 zum Ziel. Diese wird unter klar definierten Bedingungen Fehlerursachen identifizieren und geeignete Maßnahmen zu deren Vermeidung definieren bzw. einleiten.

Name: ADDI-DATA Group
Description:
We make the electronics that turn a sensor signal or a bus message into a number and a result you can trust.

ADDI-DATA has built data acquisition boards and systems in Rheinmünster, Germany, since 1984. More than 400 customers a year use them in machines, test benches and production lines. Everything carries a part number you can reorder, including versions built for one customer.

Two steps decide whether a measurement is right: acquiring the signal, and turning it into a result on the spot. Both are ours. Your PLC, SCADA and MES stay as they are, and we deliver into them over EtherCAT, PROFINET, OPC UA, Modbus TCP and CAN, without a gateway.

 What we measure

Temperature with thermocouples and Pt100. Voltage and current, 4 to 20 mA. Strain gauges and load cells. Inductive and LVDT probes. Vibration with IEPE. Counting, frequency, timing. Digital I/O, serial and CAN.

Position read directly, with no converter: EnDat 2.2, BiSS-C Master, SSI, sin/cos, resolver, incremental.

 Who we work with

Machine builders who need the same board to behave identically for twenty years, in a version made for their machine.

System integrators whose margin lives in engineering hours, and who need hardware that configures rather than develops.

Test and validation teams building the bench that measures their own product.

 Customisation that ends in a part number

Feasibility study, custom electronics, FPGA firmware, drivers, a dedicated variant with its own part number. Every service starts from a product and ends in one.

 What you get

Hardened by design: optical isolation, overvoltage and short-circuit protection, EMI filtering, extended temperature versions.

One driver package, ADDI-PACK: Windows, Linux, Xenomai, RTX. Change the hardware, keep the code.

Long-term availability, committed in writing.

Tell us what you need to measure. You get an answer from an engineer.

Name: ROS-Industrial
Description:
Our Brief History

The ROS-Industrial Open Source project began as the collaborative endeavor of Yaskawa Motoman Robotics, Southwest Research Institute, and Willow Garage to support the use of ROS for manufacturing automation. The software repository, hosted on GitHub, was founded by Shaun Edwards (SwRI) in January 2012. Led by SwRI, the ROS-Industrial Consortium Americas launched in March 2013. As you might have guessed from the name, there is also a ROS-I Consortium Europe, led by Fraunhofer IPA in Stuttgart, Germany, and a ROS-Industrial Consortium Asia Pacific, led by ARTC and NTU in Singapore. The Consortia exists to support the ROS-Industrial community by providing training, technical support, and setting the roadmap for ROS-I. The Consortia also conduct pre-competitive joint industry projects to develop new capabilities for ROS-I.

MVTec HALCON is optimized for the needs of OEMs and system integrators and allows engineers to set up their own solutions for a specific machine vision task.

MVTec MERLIC is a powerful no-code machine vision software that enables users to quickly build complete solutions intuitively and without programming.

The MVTec Deep Learning Tool is a comprehensive software tool for preparing image data and supporting data-driven workflows for the deployment of deep-learning-based machine vision applications.

Solutions: Furthermore, MVTec builds customized software solutions for machine vision – from consultancy, studies, and prototypes up to integrated products. Software solutions can be based on standard PC or embedded hardware (e.g., Arm-based systems). Moreover, MVTec’s team has an excellent background in processing images of different kinds, including 3D, infrared, hyperspectral, and X-ray images.

Name: HaRo Anlagen- und Fördertechnik GmbH
Description:
HaRo ist seit über 50 Jahren für effiziente und robuste Förderanlagen für Stückgüter bekannt. Aus einem großen Pool von Standard-Systemen entwickeln die Kundenberater in Workshops in Zusammenarbeit mit den zukünftigen Anwendern genau die Wunsch-Anlage des Kunden. Dabei geht es von der einfachen Streckenführung von A nach B bis zu komplizierten Verzweigungen über mehrere Etagen und vielen Zielen. Die Bandbreite auserlesener Systemkomponenten bietet dabei eine Vielzahl von Lösungswegen, die durch das modulare Baukastensystem flexibel dem jeweiligen Anforderungsprofil angepasst werden kann. Die in Serie gefertigten Komponenten der unterschiedlichsten Fördersysteme, werden an unserem Standort in Rüthen geplant, konstruiert, gefertigt, vormontiert und elektrisch in Testbetrieb genommen und erst nach einem umfangreichen Ausgangs-Check erfolgt die Auslieferung mit unserem eigenen Fuhrpark zur Kundenbaustelle. So gewährleisten wir eine maximale Zuverlässigkeit und beanspruchen nur kurz die kostbare Kundenzeit bei der Umstellung. Durch die Förderanlagen von HaRo haben sich unzählige Produktionsbetriebe, vornehmlich im Mittelstand mit modernster Logistik einen erheblichen Marktvorsprung verschafft. Die Vorteile der HaRo-Förderanlagen liegen auf der Hand, Effizienzsteigerungen gepaart mit Kostensenkungen kommen dem Unternehmen zugute. Zudem wird auch das Arbeitsumfeld der Mitarbeiter optimiert und durch Ergonomie-Elemente humanisiert. Für eine Anbindung mehrerer Etagen bietet der HaRo-Vertikalförderer als eingebundener Lastenaufzug unermüdliche Dienste. So werden die Stockwerke des Gebäudes mühelos überwunden und vollständig in die Logistikkette integriert. HaRo - Made in Germany, davon sind seit Jahrzehnten zahlreiche Kunden der unterschiedlichsten Branchen in der langen Firmengeschichte überzeugt. Das Spektrum der Investoren und Betreiber reicht von kleinen- und mittelständischen Unternehmen bis hin zu weltweit agierenden Großkonzernen.

HaRo...und die Produktion rollt.

Ziel von InterOpera ist die Entwicklung von 50 konkreten, praktikablen und interoperablen Teilmodellen der VWS für möglichst viele Geschäftsbereiche entlang des Referenzarchitekturmodells 4.0 (RAMI 4.0), vom Shopfloor bis hin zu allgemeinen Geschäftsprozessen. Industrieunternehmen aus dem ganzen Bundesgebiet sind ab sofort aufgerufen, Anwendungsfälle für die Teilmodelle zu benennen. Software and hardware for automatic and secure personal identification! "Anti-spoofing" or "anti-tail gating" solutions make the biometric access control solution secure, user-friendly and efficient with maximum throughput. The product range extends from biometric registration stations to automated passport control (APC) kiosks, access control and border control gates (ABC).

The products like FaceBar | FaceScreen | FaceGate | FaceTower are used for sensitive production or office locations, airports, stadiums, leisure parks, casinos, etc.

MODI Trace | Industrial image processing:

With the patented Adomo technology, all types of codes and plain text (OCR) of delivered components are recognized and automatically matched with the individual ERP system. With this input- and quality control, all registrated products are always traceable.
 
MODI products are used everywhere where components are delivered and installed, such as in the automotive, pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries.

Deliver Software-Only Motion Control and Machine Vision Positioning Systems Quickly and Affordably 

KINGSTAR Soft Motion is an open and standards-based, software-only solution that streamlines motion control and automation. Soft Motion runs directly on the PC, uses the NIC card for I/O, and uses the powerful EtherCAT protocol to free you from the shackles of proprietary and costly hardware. With Soft Motion, motion control engineers can design, develop and integrate PC-based machine controllers in a “plug-and-play” environment for consolidated, inexpensive and scalable motion control and machine vision. Build motion control applications with KINGSTAR’s soft motion library and software PLC. Built on the foundation of EtherCAT and a real-time 64-bit Windows operating system, it provides a complete platform for control and automation engineering.

• Reduce costs - Replace hardware with software to reduce machine control costs by 25-50%.

• Speed time-to-market - Improve productivity with pre-integrated motion libraries and EtherCAT auto-configuration.

• Enhance performance - Improve machine performance and control by using the PC NIC, Ethernet cables and EtherCAT infrastructure.

• Scale dynamically - Auto-configure an EtherCAT network when swapping any servo drives and I/O devices.

• Extend easily - Add any 3rd party protocols or open source libraries with no vendor lock-in.

• Improve UX - Build a powerful UI with a world-class Windows Interface (HMI)

Description:
ZS-Handling Technologies offers non-contact ultrasonic handling systems for sensitive substrates, which enable contactless pick & place, conveying, sorting, loading and unloading as well as inspection of components.
Thanks to ultrasonic technology, contactless handling of processed or coated surfaces, including flexible substrates, is possible. By avoiding surface contact, micro-scratches, micro-cracks or other damage can be prevented.
Since no additional air is brought in for the air bearing, our systems do not generate any turbulence or carry-over of impurities in the air. This significantly reduces the risk of particle contamination, which makes our systems well suited for cleanrooms.
In contrast to conventional air bearings, our technology does not require the generation of compressed air with complex and cost-intensive air treatment. Our handling tools only require an electrical power supply and, if necessary, a vacuum connection (negative pressure). Therefore, the energy consumption is reduced, and the operating costs are very low.

SMARTFILL - Precision Ball Mill Fill-Level Measurement

The acoustic fill-level sensor that started a revolution in grinding control. More than 800 units installed globally on cement, raw meal, coal, and minerals mills. Reliable, maintenance-free, and the foundation for stable mill operation.

KILNPILOT - AI-Based Kiln Process Control

Real-time optimisation of your pyroprocessing line. KILNPILOT stabilises kiln operation, reduces thermal energy consumption, and protects refractory, using advanced algorithms trained on decades of cement process expertise.

KILNCOOLER - Infrared-Controlled Kiln Shell Cooling

Water-mist cooling precisely where your kiln needs it. Infrared sensors monitor shell temperature continuously & target cooling to hotspots, protecting steel, extending refractory life and reducing cooling fan energy by up to 30%. Available as mobile or stationary unit.

GASTEMPflow - Acoustic Gas Temperature & Flow Measurement

Contactless measurement of temperature & flow velocity in dusty, high-temperature gas streams. Designed for preheater towers, rotary kilns, and clinker coolers. No probes, no maintenance, no drift.

SMARTCONTROL - Your Plant Data, Connected

The software platform that ties it all together: data acquisition, process visualisation, advanced control, and predictive maintenance in one interface.

Name: SAW-Airwalls
Description:

Tore und andere Durchgänge bleiben dabei barrierefrei nutzbar, gekühlte oder erwärmte Luft entweicht aber nicht aus den Bereichen, wo sie gebraucht wird.

Airwalls zeichnen sich durch hohe Energieeffizienz aus und verringern die Last – und somit den Energiebedarf – von Klimatechnikanlagen. Mit seinen patentierten Produkten hilft LWT-Airwalls Emissionen zu senken und macht damit Nachhaltigkeits- und Umweltschutzziele von Unternehmen einfacher erreichbar. Das Unternehmen betreibt dafür eigene Forschung und Entwicklung, unter anderem gemeinsam mit renommierten Instituten. 

Anwendung finden Airwalls überall dort, wo Räume oder Fahrzeuge aus energieeffizienten, gesundheitlichen oder kostensparenden Gründen isoliert werden müssen, zum Beispiel im Handel, in Müllentsorgungsbetrieben, in der Logistik, in Produktionsbetrieben und in öffentlichen Gebäuden. Dabei erfüllen Airwalls zudem die hohen Anforderungen des Bundes-Immissionsschutzgesetz. Wissenschaftlich bestätigt wurde auch die Wirksamkeit gegen Insekten und Staubpartikel.

2.000 Luftwandanlagen wurden bereits verbaut und sorgen für Schutz vor Temperatur, Geruch, Gasen, Staub und Durchzug.

Das Haupteinsatzgebiet unserer Sensorik ist dabei das Structural Health Monitoring von Ingenieurbauwerken wie Windkraftanlagen oder Brücken. Dank der Datenverarbeitung mit unseren hocheffizienten Analysealgorithmen wird eine Echtzeitüberwachung des statisch-dynamischen Verhaltens der Bauteile möglich. Zuführsysteme:
Unsere Zuführsysteme werden als komplette, kundenspezifische Lösungen geliefert. Sie bestehen aus einem stabilen Stahl- oder Aluminiumgestell und einem Schwingförderer in Zylinder-, Kegel- oder Stufenbauweise mit Durchmessern bis ca. 2m. Angetrieben von bewährten Komponenten deutscher Hersteller, gewährleisten verschiedene Kunststoffbeschichtungen eine schonende Bauteilführung. Stufenhubförderer:
Stufenhubförderer eignen sich ideal zur Zuführung flach liegender oder langer Bauteile. Sie verfügen über eine Bunkerwanne zur Bevorratung und werden wahlweise elektrisch oder pneumatisch angetrieben. Die Fördereinheit lässt sich in der Breite anpassen und kann mit oder ohne Vereinzelung geliefert werden – für maximale Flexibilität in der Anwendung.

Montageanlagen:
Unsere Montageanlagen werden als Stand-Alone-Lösungen mit eigenem Gestell, Schutzeinhausung und Steuerung realisiert. Der Aufbau erfolgt entweder auf einem Rundschalttisch oder als Linearstrecke. Die Zuführung der Bauteile erfolgt wahlweise integriert oder extern. Die Anlagen sind modular aufgebaut, zuverlässig im Dauerbetrieb und leicht in bestehende Fertigungslinien integrierbar.

Service:

Sie wollen eine neue Maschinengeneration auf den Markt bringen.

Wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, Ihre Wünsche und Erwartungen an Ihre Geschäftspartner, durch eine kundennahe, bewegliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise zu erfüllen.

Unser Mittelpunkt liegt hierbei in der technischen Betreuung Ihrer Antriebsaufgaben von Ihren ersten Überlegungen bis zur erfolgreichen Auslieferung Ihrer Maschinen. Eine reibungslose Abwicklung ins In- und Ausland ist daher selbstverständlich.

Name: Dr. Eis
Description:
Die Trockeneisreinigung ist eine distruptive Technologie im Bereich der Reinigung und gilt als besonders effektiv, effizient und schonend. 

Die meisten Objekte können im eingebauten Zustand, bei Betriebstemperatur gereinigt werden. Das führt nicht nur zu einem besseren Reinigungsergebnis, sondern auch zu einem erheblichen Zeitvorteil. Die Trockeneisreinigung funktioniert dabei ohne Chemikalien (Reinigungsmittel, Lösungsmittel etc.) oder Strahlenmittel.
Bei dem Verfahren beschleunigt die Strahlanlage bis zu 3 mm große Trockeneispellets mit Druckluft auf über 150 m/s. Durch die Kälte von -79 °c gefriert der Schmutz und bekommt Risse. Mittels des nachfolgenden Luftstroms und der Trockeneispellets wird der Schmutz einfach abgelöst. Eine besonders effiziente Methode, welche nahezu jeden Schmutz materialschonend entfernt.


Vorteile der Trockeneisreinigung:
- Reinigen ohne Vorarbeit, Werkzeuge und Geräte müssen nicht zerlegt werden
- Zeitvorteil
- Es bleibt kein Strahlmittel zurück. Der abgelöste Schmutz fällt zu Boden und kann aufgekehrt werden.
- Umweltfreundlich ( kein Chemikalien, antiallergisch, ohne Wasser)
- CO2 fällt als Nebenprodukt aus anderen Verarbeitungsprozessen in der Industrie an
- Oberflächen werden nicht beschädigg
- Einsetzbar in Bereichen, in denen eine Reinigung mit Wasser und Sand gesetzlich verboten sind

Name: HS High Stake GmbH
Description:
High Stake GmbH, a German deep-tech company, builds a high-precision camera calibration station for robotics, ADAS, industrial vision and camera quality assurance.

Our system combines a compact Mac mini-based setup, a monitor used as an active calibration target, and polished calibration software for accurate, repeatable and well-documented camera calibration.

Instead of relying only on static checkerboards or CharUCO boards, our station uses active phase-shifted patterns displayed on a monitor. This enables dense full-frame measurements, including the image edges where wide-angle and fisheye cameras often show the largest calibration errors.

The pipeline supports standard OpenCV-compatible camera models as well as our advanced free-form model for complex optics. It provides validation reports with physically meaningful metrics such as forward projection error, expected forward projection error, reproducibility and reliability.

In our experiment with a 5 MP industrial camera, our MAT-based workflow reduced RMS reprojection error from 0.68 px with an OpenCV + CharUCO baseline to 0.21 px with MAT + free-form calibration. MAT target decoding achieved approximately 17 ± 10 μm measurement uncertainty.

High Stake GmbH was founded in Karlsruhe, Germany in 2017. Our background is in custom software engineering, industrial systems and computer vision R&D.

Our camera calibration technology has been used in paid proof-of-concept projects by leading international R&D teams in automotive, consumer electronics, industrial research and advanced imaging.

Typical use cases include wide-angle and fisheye camera calibration, robotics and ROS-based vision systems, ADAS cameras, industrial inspection, stereo and multi-camera calibration, and camera QA / end-of-line validation.

If your product depends on camera accuracy across the full image frame, our calibration station helps you measure, validate and improve it.

Bereits bei kleinen mittelständischen Unternehmen mit rund 50 Mitarbeitern werden für nicht wertschöpfenden Tätigkeiten rund 2 Mitarbeiter für Kommissionierung, Montage, Fertigungs- und Prüfprozesse mit

- Drucken und Verteilung der Papier-Dokumente,
- Handschriftliche Notizen zur Abarbeitung,
- Rückgabe der Dokumente,
- Eingabe der Dokumenten- Inhalte zur Eingabe in ein Warenwirtschaftssystem.

funkgesteuerte Anzeige-Module mit Rückmelde-Möglichkeit und
Lokalisierungsfunktion,

Sprachsteuerung am Smartphone und Tablet

um die papier-basierte Vorgabe, Abarbeitung und Rückmeldung komplett in Echtzeit zu digitalisieren.



Sprach-Steuerung (Sprach-Vorgaben für den Mitarbeiter, und Spracheingaben für Beschreibungen und Rückmeldungen) wirken in gleicher Weise wie die Anzeige- Module, der Aufwand für papier- basierte Vorgaben wie Rückmeldungen entfällt.
